description: BEAM deterministic fixture — 2 conversations, 14 facts, 10 probes

messages.content: I'm building an agent memory system called Ohara. It should be a single binary.
A single binary memory system is a great constraint. What storage engine are you considering?
SQLite with FTS5 for search, pure-Go only. No CGO.
modernc.org/sqlite gives you pure-Go SQLite. For vectors, the vec0 extension is available now.
The vec0 extension is in modernc v1.47.0+. But we need to stay on v1.45.0 for now.
Understood. For small N (<1000 items), brute-force cosine works fine in Go.
How should we handle memory deduplication?
Use normalized_hash on the content body. Store it in the database and check on insert.
What about topic_key upserts? Should we keep those?
Yes, topic_key upserts are critical. They allow evolving topics to update a single observation over time.
And for soft-deletes — we use deleted_at, right?
Correct. Never hard-delete. Set deleted_at and filter in queries. This preserves the audit trail.
